problems.title: Sound familiar?
problems.intro: These are the problems business owners tell us about most often — and how we fix them.

items.title: Too much manual work
items.text: Your team copies the same data between Excel, chats and programs.
items.system: Automations that move the data for you.
items.outcome: Your team gets time back for real work.

items.title: Lost customer inquiries
items.text: Messages come from Instagram, WhatsApp, the website and calls — and some never get an answer.
items.system: One inbox for every inquiry, with an AI assistant that replies right away.

items.title: Slow replies to customers
items.text: Customers wait hours for answers to the same simple questions.
items.system: An AI assistant that knows your products and rules, and calls a person for hard cases.
items.outcome: Fast, correct answers — even at night.

items.title: Programs that don't talk to each other
items.text: Your CRM, accounting and warehouse each show different numbers.
items.system: We connect your programs so the data moves between them by itself.
items.outcome: One set of numbers everyone trusts.

items.title: No clear view of sales
items.text: You only see how sales went after the month is over.
items.system: A live dashboard with your key numbers.

items.title: Paperwork and reminders
items.text: Invoices, reminders, reports and approvals take up the whole week.

categories.name: Sales
friction: Leads arrive from many channels with no single owner
Follow-ups depend on memory and sticky notes
Pipeline status lives in someone's head

system.name: Sales command system
system.description: One pipeline that captures every inquiry, qualifies it with AI and schedules the next step automatically.

improvements: A live pipeline view for leadership

categories.name: Operations
friction: Data re-typed between spreadsheets and tools
Approvals stuck in chats and inboxes
No clear view of what is late or blocked

system.name: Operations backbone
system.description: Connected workflows and a shared data layer that move work between people and tools without copy-paste.

improvements: Bottlenecks visible before they become problems

categories.name: Customer Support
friction: The same questions answered by hand every day
Context lost between channels and agents

system.name: AI support layer
system.description: An assistant trained on your knowledge base that resolves routine questions and hands complex cases to people with full context.

improvements: Agents focused on cases that need a human

categories.name: Marketing
friction: Reports assembled by hand from several platforms
Audiences and content managed in silos

system.name: Marketing data loop
system.description: Lead capture, attribution and reporting connected end to end, so marketing sees what actually turns into revenue.

improvements: A clearer view of which channels perform

categories.name: Booking
friction: Double bookings across staff or locations

system.name: Booking automation
system.description: Online scheduling connected to calendars, reminders and payments — with rules that match how you really operate.

improvements: A calendar that reflects real availability

categories.name: Data
friction: Numbers differ depending on who you ask

system.name: Single source of truth
system.description: Integrations that consolidate your systems into one clean data layer, with live dashboards on top.

improvements: One set of numbers everyone trusts

solutions.title: What we can build for your business.
solutions.intro: Seven services. Pick the one closest to your problem — or just describe the problem, and we'll suggest the right mix.

ai-systems.lead: AI that does real work inside your business — grounded in your data, measured by what it changes.
problems: Teams spend hours reading, sorting and answering the same requests
Knowledge sits in documents nobody can search
Decisions wait for someone to compile information
deliverables: AI agents with tools and guardrails
Evaluation and monitoring of AI quality

automation.lead: The repetitive steps between your tools, handled automatically and reliably.
problems: Data copied between systems by hand
Approvals and notifications lost in chats
Reports rebuilt from scratch every week
deliverables: Integrations between CRM, email, messengers and finance

custom-software.lead: When off-the-shelf software forces workarounds, we build the system your process actually needs.
problems: Critical work runs on fragile spreadsheets
Several tools stitched together with manual steps
Licences paid for features nobody uses

business-applications.lead: CRM, operations and management applications fitted to how your company sells and delivers.
problems: Generic CRM that nobody keeps up to date
No single place for clients, orders and documents
Access and permissions handled informally

web-experiences.lead: Websites and interactive experiences that explain complex value clearly — and convert.
problems: The website no longer reflects the company
Complex offers are hard to understand online
Slow pages and weak search visibility

sales-systems.lead: Every inquiry captured, qualified and followed up — with leadership seeing the pipeline live.
problems: Leads scattered across channels
Follow-up depends on individual memory
Forecasts built on guesswork

internal-tools.lead: Focused tools that remove daily friction for your team — fast to build, easy to use.
problems: Teams switching between many tabs for one task
Managers lacking a live operational view
Manual exports and recalculations

about.title: We help businesses work faster with AI, automation and software.
about.intro: We are business analysts, designers and engineers in one team. First we understand how your company works, then we build the technology that fits it.
about.manifesto: Good systems are almost invisible. People simply notice that work got easier.

approach.title: We learn your business
approach.text: We learn how the company sells, delivers and makes decisions before we propose anything.

approach.title: We see the whole picture
approach.text: We look at the whole chain — people, processes, data and tools — not a single screen.

approach.title: Simple to use
approach.text: Interfaces and workflows are designed to be obvious for the people who use them every day.

approach.title: Reliable technology
approach.text: Clean architecture, solid integrations and security are part of the design, not afterthoughts.

approach.title: AI where it helps
approach.text: We use AI where it measurably helps, with guardrails, review and a human in the loop.

approach.title: We stay with you
approach.text: We stay to measure, maintain and extend what we build as the business changes.

is: A partner that starts with the business problem.
One team that designs and engineers the whole system.
A studio that stays to improve what it builds.
not: Not a reseller of someone else's tools.
Not a team that disappears after launch.

engagement.title: Evolve
engagement.text: Ongoing support, measurement and new capabilities as the business grows.
